muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿والعصر﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and genitive, and «العصر» is a noun genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of oath, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of oath, and the oath clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with no grammatical position.
﴿الإنسان﴾: the noun (ism) of «إن», accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿لفي﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «في» is a preposition.
﴿خسر﴾: a noun genitive (majrūr) by ﴿في﴾, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the clause ﴿إن الإنسان لفي خسر﴾ is the answer of the oath, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception.
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the excepted (mustathnā).
﴿آمنوا﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وعملوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «عملوا» is a past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of nominative as fāʿil; the clause ﴿عملوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿الصالحات﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿عملوا﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿وتواصوا﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, and the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of nominative as fāʿil; the clause ﴿تواصوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿بالحق﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «الحق» is a noun genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تواصوا﴾.
﴿وتواصوا﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, and the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of nominative as fāʿil; the clause ﴿تواصوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿بالصبر﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «الصبر» is a noun genitive by the bāʾ, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تواصوا﴾.
